Name: Fancy Artisan Goods Icons Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4]I started making  retextures for myself some time ago, but later I really wanted to make a mod with all of it, so here it is! Hope you'll like it.

[list]
[*]Highly configurable! You can combine this mod with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods mod[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13705]Wildflour's Cuter Artisan Goods[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4908]Peachy Objects[/url] or other retextures if you want.
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080][u]Better Artisan Good Icons[/u][/url] is supported (for now will work on 1.5.6  Stardew only), you can [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15149][u][b]download it here![/b][/u][/url]
[/list]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4]
[/size][/font]More fancy retextures mods:[font=Georgia][size=4]
[list]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14070]Crops and Forage[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14180]Resources[/url]
[*][url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14168]Fish and Tackles[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14122]Rings&Shoes[/url]
[/list]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4]
[b][u][color=#dbb0a7]Configuration:[/color][/u][/b]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Duck feather - green, black, white;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Void egg - black, purple;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Rabbit's foot - paw, carrot, golden carrot;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Pale Ale - old, new, new;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Truffle Oil - old, new, new1.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=4]
[u][color=#dbb0a7]Now time for credits:[/color][/u]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Many icons taken from this  [url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/pixel-food]Free Pixel Food tileset[/url]  by [url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/]Henry Software[/url]﻿ (God bless the man, his pixel art is sooo good!)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Fairy Dust bag texture is from[url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/godot-pixel-items] [/url][url=http:///henrysoftware.itch.io/godot-pixel-items]godot pixel items pack[/url]﻿﻿[url=http://][/url]﻿  by [url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/]Henry Software[/url]﻿ [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The Pale Ale texture is from [url=http://www.deviantart.com/orteil/art/A-whole-lot-of-RPG-items-379986564]this free RPG items tilesheet[/url]﻿ by  [url=http://www.deviantart.com/orteil]Orteil[/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Icons for Milk and Goat Milk bottles taken from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2494]Glass Milk Bottles mod[/url] by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43737222]andiluxe[/url] ﻿﻿(I slightly recolored them)﻿[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]A lot of inspiration came from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] (and also some color palletes too).[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The Rice Bag is actually slightly retextured Bundle Bag texture from Minecraft.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Feather texture is from [url=https://vk.com/away.php?utf=1&to=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.vectorstock.com%2Froyalty-free-vector%2Fset-of-feathers-in-pixel-style-vector-20040341]this asset pack.[/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Cloth texture is from [url=https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-items-zoomed]Jetrel's items 16x16 pack[/url]﻿.﻿[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Also many inspiration an references came from Pinterest and Google search stock images.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][b][center][/center][/b][/font]
